system.description:
1/turn · 1 Action · Costs: 1 Toolbelt scrap.

You deploy a turret in an adjacent space. Turrets activate when deployed.

[A] Pick one of your known turrets (Rifle plus your Mechanical Mayhem picks); the module places it in an adjacent space (the GM's client creates it for you) and gives you ownership of it.

[A] Costs are paid in one chat card with Undo: 1 Action, 1 Toolbelt scrap (or the Testing In Progress! free deploy) and the 1/turn use. Undo refunds them and removes the turret (a turret it replaced comes back). With no scrap left you are told so and asked whether to deploy anyway (nothing is spent then — for a miscounted Toolbelt).

[A] The 1/turn limit is a counter on this feature (refills at the start of your turn; click it to correct mistakes); Master Technician ignores it and allows 2 active turrets.

[A] The turret activates on deploy: its basic action opens right away (free) — or press Fire on the deploy card later. Later activations cost 1 Action each (see Activate Turret).

[A] The spawned turret gets its destruction threshold (LVL, 2xLVL with Extra Plating), INT scaling, Overclocked bonuses and your save DC automatically.

[M] Mechanical Prodigy (level 20): drag the turret anywhere within Reach 8 after it is placed.
